_instructions.title: IT ANNOUNCEMENTS - EDIT GUIDE (Ise Edit Nahi Karna Hai)
_instructions.description: Nayi announcement daalne ke liye, neeche di gayi 'announcements' list mein sabse upar ek naya block add karein. Sabse nayi khabar hamesha list mein sabse upar honi chahiye.

fields_guide.type: Announcement ka type batayein. Use karein: 'alert' (urgent, red color), 'maintenance' (warning, orange color), ya 'info' (update, blue color).
fields_guide.date: Jis din announcement daal rahe hain, woh date likhein. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
fields_guide.title: Announcement ki ek chhoti si, bold headline.
fields_guide.content: Announcement ki poori jaankari yahan likhein.

example.tip: Example: Ek nayi maintenance ki soochana daalne ke liye, 'announcements' list mein sabse upar yeh add karein:
code: "content": "We will be installing a new firewall on Tuesday. No major downtime is expected."

announcements.title: FileZilla Server Update (DDN)
announcements.content: We will be applying critical security patches to the FileZilla server in Dehradun tonight at 10 PM. A brief disconnection of 5-10 minutes is expected.

announcements.title: Planned Internet Upgrade (Noida)
announcements.content: Our Internet Service Provider will be performing an upgrade on Monday in the Noida office. Expect brief disconnections between 9 AM and 10 AM.

announcements.title: Phishing Alert
announcements.content: A new phishing email is circulating. It claims to be from 'HR Department' about salary slips. Please do NOT click any links and report it to IT immediately.

announcements.title: Saturday Maintenance
announcements.content: This Saturday, from 2 PM to 4 PM, the main server will be under maintenance. SAP and file storage will be unavailable during this time.

announcements.title: New Antivirus Rollout
announcements.content: Starting next week, we will be upgrading all systems to the new Sophos Antivirus. No action is required from your side.

announcements.title: Updated Password Policy
announcements.content: As part of our continuous security improvement, the mandatory password length has been increased to 12 characters. Please update your password at the next prompt.
